text: Your allowance has three jobs. One part is for today. One part is for later. One part is for someone else. Spend: what you use today, like a snack or a pencil. Save: what waits for something bigger later. Share: what you give to a friend or a cause.

text: Ang interest ang kusang lumalaki ng savings account, kahit walang dinadagdag pa. Kapag iniwan nang hindi ginagalaw, kumikita ito nang kaunti bawat taon, at ang interest ng bawat taon ay kumikita pa sa ibabaw ng nauna. spokenText: Itugma ang bawat puno sa numero nito.

text: Ang malaking bagay ay gustong masyadong malaki para sa isang linggo o isang buwang baon lang. Kailangan nito ng sariling goal, sariling numero, at sariling timeline, hiwalay sa pang-araw-araw na gastos.

spokenText: Gusto mong mag-ipon ng six thousand pesos para sa phone. Kaya mong maglaan ng five hundred pesos kada buwan. Ilang buwan bago maabot ang six thousand pesos?

text: Ang baon mo ang unang budget na talagang hawak mo. Sinusundan ito ng path na ito mula sa pila sa canteen hanggang sa mga mensaheng sumusubok na agawin ito sa iyo.

text: Gross pay is what you earned. Deductions are what the law sets aside for you. Net pay is what lands in your account. SSS: 5% of your salary credit. Retirement, sickness, maternity, disability. PhilHealth: 2.5% of basic pay. Hospital bills. Pag-IBIG: 2% up to ₱200. Housing loans and savings. Withholding tax: nothing until you earn above ₱250,000 a year.
spokenText: Gross pay is what you earned. Deductions are what the law sets aside for you. Net pay is what lands in your account. SSS: 5% of your salary credit. text: Basic pay is ₱20,000. How much is the SSS deduction on this payslip?
spokenText: Basic pay is 20,000 pesos. How much is the SSS deduction on this payslip?

text: Net pay is the number your budget starts from. Not gross.
spokenText: Net pay is the number your budget starts from. Not gross.

text: Each line that leaves your pay buys something specific. Most people cannot say what.
spokenText: Each line that leaves your pay buys something specific. Most people cannot say what.

text: These are not taxes. They are memberships. Each one pays out on a day you will be glad it exists. SSS pays when you are sick, on maternity leave, disabled, unemployed, or retired. PhilHealth pays part of a hospital bill. About half of an average one, and the share has been falling. Pag-IBIG holds your savings and lends for a house.

text: Match each deduction to what it pays for.
spokenText: Match each deduction to what it pays for.

text: Deductions are the cheapest insurance you will ever hold. Check that your employer actually remits them.

text: Income tax only starts above ₱250,000 of taxable income a year. ₱20,000 a month is ₱240,000 a year, and deductions lower it further. First ₱250,000 a year: 0%. Next ₱150,000: 15%. Then 20%, 25%, 30%, 35% as income rises. Only the peso above each line is taxed at the higher rate.
spokenText: Income tax only starts above 250,000 pesos of taxable income a year. 20,000 pesos a month is 240,000 pesos a year, and deductions lower it further. First 250,000 pesos a year: 0%. text: Slide to your guess: monthly income tax on a ₱20,000 basic salary.
spokenText: Slide to your guess: monthly income tax on a 20,000 pesos basic salary.

text: Marginal means only the peso above the line is taxed more. A raise never leaves you with less.
spokenText: Marginal means only the peso above the line is taxed more. A raise never leaves you with less.

text: You started in March. In December the office talks about 13th month pay. Yours will not be a full month, and that is correct.

text: Thirteenth month pay is the basic salary you earned this year, divided by twelve. It is due by 24 December and tax-free up to ₱90,000 of bonuses. Overtime and allowances are not included. Basic pay only. Every rank-and-file employee is covered, including probationary.

text: Basic pay ₱20,000 a month, employed from March to December. What is the 13th month pay?
spokenText: Basic pay 20,000 pesos a month, employed from March to December. What is the 13th month pay?

text: A bonus that arrives once a year is the easiest money to save, because you never budgeted it.
spokenText: A bonus that arrives once a year is the easiest money to save, because you never budgeted it.

text: Ninety seconds. Ten statements about pay in the Philippines. Some are true.
spokenText: Ninety seconds. Ten statements about pay in the Philippines. Some are true.

text: The Labor Code sets floors. Employers can pay more, never less.
spokenText: The Labor Code sets floors. Employers can pay more, never less.

text: Keep every payslip. It is your proof for SSS, loans, and disputes.
spokenText: Keep every payslip. It is your proof for SSS, loans, and disputes.

text: Benefits are pay you cannot see until the day you need them.
spokenText: Benefits are pay you cannot see until the day you need them.

spokenText: A need keeps you housed, fed, working, and insured. A want is everything else. Both are allowed. Only one of them gets to move.

text: Sort each card. Left is need, right is want.
spokenText: Sort each card. Left is need, right is want.

text: You do not cut wants. You give them a size.

text: A plan is money with owners. Four jars: needs, wants, savings, debt. A common starting split is 50, 30, 20, with debt taking from wants first. Needs 50%: rent, fare, food, load, contributions. text: In the BSP survey of 2025, three in ten adults said their savings would last through an emergency. Seven in ten said no. An emergency is a job loss, a hospital stay, a typhoon, a family call. The fund is not for wants. It is the wall between you and a lending app.

text: Emergency fund = monthly needs × 3. Six months if your income is irregular or you support family. Needs from the budget lesson: ₱9,150 a month. Reach it in steps: ₱5,000 first, then one month, then three.
spokenText: Emergency fund = monthly needs × 3. Six months if your income is irregular or you support family. Needs from the budget lesson: 9,150 pesos a month. Reach it in steps: 5,000 pesos first, then one month, then three.

text: Monthly needs are ₱9,150. What is a three-month emergency fund?

text: A number you can name is a number you can reach.

text: Under the mattress it is safe from the bank and unsafe from everything else, including you.
spokenText: Under the mattress it is safe from the bank and unsafe from everything else, including you.

text: An emergency fund needs three things: reachable in a day, insured, and slightly out of sight. PDIC insures bank deposits up to ₱1,000,000 per bank. Digital banks pay more interest and are PDIC members too. MP2 and bonds are for wishes, not emergencies. They lock the money.

text: Where should the emergency fund live?

text: Separate account, same-day access, insured. Nothing more clever than that.

text: People who save successfully rarely decide to save. They decided once, and a transfer has been happening ever since.

text: An emergency fund does not stop emergencies. It changes what they cost.

text: The fund is the difference between a bad month and a bad year.
spokenText: The fund is the difference between a bad month and a bad year.

spokenText: The credit card statement says balance 10,000 pesos, minimum due 500 pesos. Paying the minimum feels like paying. It is mostly renting the debt.

text: Card interest is capped at 3% a month. On ₱10,000 that is ₱300 a month before you touch the principal. Pay ₱500: ₱300 is interest, ₱200 reduces the debt. Pay the full balance by the due date: 0% interest. The card is free.
spokenText: Card interest is capped at 3% a month. On 10,000 pesos that is 300 pesos a month before you touch the principal. Pay 500 pesos: 300 pesos is interest, 200 pesos reduces the debt. Pay the full balance by the due date: 0% interest. The card is free.

text: The minimum is the card company’s number. Yours is the full balance.

text: Borrow ₱5,000 today, return ₱6,000 in forty days. No forms. It sounds like ₱1,000.
spokenText: Borrow 5,000 pesos today, return 6,000 pesos in forty days. No forms. It sounds like 1,000 pesos.

text: The price of a loan is the interest per period and how many periods fit in a year. Five-six fits nine cycles into a year. ₱1,000 on ₱5,000 is 20% per cycle. Nine cycles a year: over 180% before compounding. A credit card at the 3% cap is 36% a year. Five-six costs five times more.
spokenText: The price of a loan is the interest per period and how many periods fit in a year. Five-six fits nine cycles into a year. 1,000 pesos on 5,000 pesos is 20% per cycle. text: Borrow ₱5,000, repay ₱6,000 in one cycle. What is the interest rate per cycle, in percent?

text: Always turn a loan into a yearly rate before you say yes.
spokenText: Always turn a loan into a yearly rate before you say yes.

text: A fixed payment does not care what month it is.

text: The hospital bill is ₱40,000. You have PhilHealth. The cashier asks for ₱17,600. Nobody explained the gap.

text: PhilHealth pays a fixed amount per condition, not a share of the bill. On average it covered about 52% of a hospital bill in 2023, down from 75% in 2018, because case rates have not kept up with hospital charges. The rest is yours, an HMO’s, or a private insurer’s. Public hospitals and ward rooms leave a smaller gap than private rooms.

spokenText: Seven in ten Filipinos were targeted by digital fraud last year. The message below reached one of them.

text: Every takeover message has the same three parts: fear, a link, and a request for a code. Learn the shape and you stop reading the words.
spokenText: Every takeover message has the same three parts: fear, a link, and a request for a code. Learn the shape and you stop reading the words.

text: Flag every line that gives it away.
spokenText: Flag every line that gives it away.

text: No bank or wallet asks for a code. Whoever asks is the thief.
spokenText: No bank or wallet asks for a code. Whoever asks is the thief.

text: A caller says she is from your bank’s fraud team and needs the code you just received to block a suspicious transfer. She sounds calm and professional.
spokenText: A caller says she is from your bank’s fraud team and needs the code you just received to block a suspicious transfer. She sounds calm and professional.

text: The code is the key. It was sent to you because a transfer is being attempted right now, by the caller. Reading it out completes the theft. Under the Anti-Financial Account Scamming Act your bank can freeze disputed funds. It cannot undo a transfer you authorised with a code. Banks are retiring SMS codes for high-risk transactions. In-app approval replaces them.

spokenText: Your cousin messages from a new account. His old one was hacked, he says, and he needs 2,000 pesos for a hospital deposit tonight.

text: Everything a scammer needs is public: names, photos, family. The one thing they cannot fake is a voice you know.
spokenText: Everything a scammer needs is public: names, photos, family. The one thing they cannot fake is a voice you know.

text: Before money moves to family, a voice confirms it. Every time.

text: Every product sits on one ladder. Higher pays more on average and can fall further in a bad year. There is no rung that does both.

text: Emergency fund at the bottom. Then government bonds and MP2. Then funds that hold many companies. Then single stocks. Crypto at the top, and it is speculation, not investing.

text: Dividends are declared yearly and vary. Compounded, ₱2,000 a month for five years becomes more than the ₱120,000 you put in. It is for a wish with a date five years out, not for emergencies. Withdraw early and you forfeit dividends.

spokenText: Dalawang sari-sari store, magkaparehong laki, magkaparehong benta; may DTI certificate na nakadikit sa counter ang isa, wala naman ang isa.

text: Nire-register ng DTI ang pangalan ng negosyo, binibigyan ito ng pangalan na walang ibang makakapagparehistro sa parehong teritoryo. Maliit at isang beses lang ang gastos ng registration kumpara sa maaaring mawala ng hindi rehistradong pangalan sa hinaharap. Puwedeng ipagtanggol ang rehistradong pangalan kung may ibang negosyo na susubok gumamit ng pareho malapit dito. Karaniwang unang dokumentong hinihingi ang DTI certificate kapag nagbubukas ng business bank account o nag-aapply ng maliit na loan.

text: Nagre-register ang DTI ng pangalan ng negosyo. Hiwalay na status ang BMBE, para sa negosyong may assets na hanggang ₱3,000,000, na nag-eexempt sa negosyo mula sa income tax sa kita nito. Ang BIR registration, hiwalay ulit, ang nagpapahintulot sa negosyong makapag-isyu ng opisyal na resibo.

text: I-match ang bawat termino sa talagang ginagawa nito para sa maliit na negosyo.

spokenText: Magkaibang tanong ang sinasagot ng DTI, BMBE, at BIR. Wala sa kanila ang kapalit ng dalawa pa.

text: Dalawang taon nang tumatakbo ang sari-sari store batay sa instinct: busy karamihan ng araw, walang pera sa dulo ng karamihan ng buwan.
spokenText: Dalawang taon nang tumatakbo ang sari-sari store batay sa instinct: busy karamihan ng araw, walang pera sa dulo ng karamihan ng buwan.

spokenText: Sinasagot ng araw-araw na record ang tanong kung talagang kumikita ba ang tindahan, hindi ng cash box na mukhang puno.

text: Magkaibang claim ang cash box na parang puno at ang tindahang talagang kumikita. Ang record lang ang makakapagsabi ng pagkakaiba.
spokenText: Magkaibang claim ang cash box na parang puno at ang tindahang talagang kumikita. Ang record lang ang makakapagsabi ng pagkakaiba.

text: Apat na termino ng BIR ang laman ng folder ng isang freelancer, at wala nang matandaan kung alin ang para saan.
spokenText: Apat na termino ng BIR ang laman ng folder ng isang freelancer, at wala nang matandaan kung alin ang para saan.

text: Sinasagot ng bawat termino ng BIR ang ibang sandali sa taon ng freelancer: pagrehistro, pagdeklara ng kita bawat quarter, pag-file ng annual return, at pag-isyu ng resibo. I-match ang bawat isa sa layunin nito.

text: I-match ang bawat termino sa gamit nito.
spokenText: I-match ang bawat termino sa gamit nito.

text: Apat na termino, apat na magkaibang sandali sa parehong taon. Wala sa mga ito ang optional kapag rehistrado na.

text: Hindi pa kailanman inikumpara ng freelancer na kumikita ng ₱600,000 gross ngayong taon ang dalawang paraan na pinapayagan ng BIR na pagbuwisan ang kitang iyon.
spokenText: Hindi pa kailanman inikumpara ng freelancer na kumikita ng six hundred thousand pesos gross ngayong taon ang dalawang paraan na pinapayagan ng BIR na pagbuwisan ang kitang iyon.

text: Puwedeng pumili ng 8% na buwis sa gross sales lampas ₱250,000 ang freelancer o maliit na negosyo na may gross sales na hanggang ₱3,000,000, sa halip na ang graduated income tax rates kasama ang hiwalay na percentage tax. Hindi rin binubuwisan ang unang ₱250,000 ng gross ng taon, sa ilalim ng 8% option. Pinapalitan ng 8% option ang income tax at percentage tax sa iisang flat rate.
spokenText: Puwedeng pumili ng eight percent na buwis sa gross sales lampas two hundred fifty thousand pesos ang freelancer o maliit na negosyo na may gross sales na hanggang three million pesos, sa halip na ang graduated income tax rates kasama ang hiwalay na percentage tax. Hindi rin binubuwisan ang unang two hundred fifty thousand pesos ng gross ng taon, sa ilalim ng eight percent option. Pinapalitan ng eight percent option ang income tax at percentage tax sa iisang flat rate.

text: Kumikita ang freelancer ng ₱600,000 gross ngayong taon at pinili ang 8% option. Magkano ang utang na buwis?
spokenText: Kumikita ang freelancer ng six hundred thousand pesos gross ngayong taon at pinili ang eight percent option. Magkano ang utang na buwis?

text: Aplay lang ang 8% option kung mas mababa sa ₱3,000,000 ang gross; hindi pa rin binubuwisan ang unang ₱250,000 sa alinmang paraan.
spokenText: Aplay lang ang eight percent option kung mas mababa sa three million pesos ang gross; hindi pa rin binubuwisan ang unang two hundred fifty thousand pesos sa alinmang paraan.

text: Dumarating ang ika-15 ng Abril sa parehong paraan bawat taon, at bihirang handa ang mga dokumento ng freelancer bago pa ang linggong iyon.
spokenText: Dumarating ang ika-fifteen ng Abril sa parehong paraan bawat taon, at bihirang handa ang mga dokumento ng freelancer bago pa ang linggong iyon.

text: May fixed na pagkakasunod ang annual filing, at puwedeng mangyari ang karamihan dito buwan bago ang deadline sa ika-15 ng Abril.
spokenText: May fixed na pagkakasunod ang annual filing, at puwedeng mangyari ang karamihan dito buwan bago ang deadline sa ika-fifteen ng Abril.

text: Ilagay sa tamang pagkakasunod-sunod ang mga hakbang sa annual filing.
spokenText: Ilagay sa tamang pagkakasunod-sunod ang mga hakbang sa annual filing.

text: Isang hakbang lang ang pag-file bago mag-15 Abril. Ang pagtipon ng resibo ng taon ang siyang talagang umuubos ng mga buwan bago nito.
spokenText: Isang hakbang lang ang pag-file bago mag-fifteen Abril. Ang pagtipon ng resibo ng taon ang siyang talagang umuubos ng mga buwan bago nito.

text: Iwinagayway ng customer ang resibo: “Hindi na kailangan.” Nagtago pa rin ng kopya ang freelancer.
spokenText: Iwinagayway ng customer ang resibo: “Hindi na kailangan.” Nagtago pa rin ng kopya ang freelancer.

text: Nagpapatunay ang resibo ng dalawang bagay nang sabay: kita para sa nag-isyu, at gastos para sa tumanggap. Puwedeng kailanganin ito ng dalawang panig sa hinaharap, sa mga dahilang wala nang kinalaman sa benta mismo. Sumusuporta ang resibong itinago ng freelancer sa gross sales na inireport sa oras ng pag-file.
spokenText: Nagpapatunay ang resibo ng dalawang bagay nang sabay: kita para sa nag-isyu, at gastos para sa tumanggap. text: Nag-isyu ang freelancer ng resibo para sa ₱5,000 na proyekto. Para saan talaga ang resibo?
spokenText: Nag-isyu ang freelancer ng resibo para sa five thousand pesos na proyekto. Para saan talaga ang resibo?

text: Sinusuportahan ng resibo ang dalawang claim nang sabay: ang kita ng nagbenta at ang gastos ng bumili.
spokenText: Sinusuportahan ng resibo ang dalawang claim nang sabay: ang kita ng nagbenta at ang gastos ng bumili.

text: Lumipas ang ika-15 ng Abril. Natipon ang mga resibo ng freelancer sa ika-20, hindi bago nito.
spokenText: Lumipas ang ika-fifteen ng Abril. Natipon ang mga resibo ng freelancer sa ika-twenty, hindi bago nito.

text: Sinusubok ng huling pag-file kung ano na ang alam ng freelancer: kailangan ng return ang resibo ng buong taon, hindi ng isang linggo lang.
spokenText: Sinusubok ng huling pag-file kung ano na ang alam ng freelancer: kailangan ng return ang resibo ng buong taon, hindi ng isang linggo lang.

text: Kailangan ng return na na-file sa oras ng resibong tinipon buong taon. Nagdaragdag ng bill na wala sa orihinal na buwis ang return na na-file nang huli.
spokenText: Kailangan ng return na na-file sa oras ng resibong tinipon buong taon. Nagdaragdag ng bill na wala sa orihinal na buwis ang return na na-file nang huli.

text: Ito ang mga taon na pinakamabilis kumapal ang utang, credit, at family plans, maganda man o hindi. Nagsisimula ang lahat dito sa utang na dala na, tapos lumalawak papunta sa account, sa bubong, at sa family plan sa paligid nito.
spokenText: Ito ang mga taon na pinakamabilis kumapal ang utang, credit, at family plans, maganda man o hindi. Nagsisimula ang lahat dito sa utang na dala na, tapos lumalawak papunta sa account, sa bubong, at sa family plan sa paligid nito.

text: You are 45, earning ₱45,000 a month. Somewhere in your plans is a number labelled "pension". Most people have never checked what it actually is.
spokenText: You are 45, earning 45,000 pesos a month. Somewhere in your plans is a number labelled "pension". Most people have never checked what it actually is.

text: SSS pays the highest of three formulas, computed from your average monthly salary credit and your credited years. The result, for most retirees, is about ₱5,000 to ₱6,000 a month, rising 10% a year through 2027. Average monthly salary credit (AMSC): roughly your average declared salary over your working life, capped by the contribution ceiling. Credited years (CYS): the years SSS has contributions on record for you, not years employed. The minimum pension itself rises in steps, from ₱1,200 to ₱2,400, depending on CYS.
spokenText: SSS pays the highest of three formulas, computed from your average monthly salary credit and your credited years. The result, for most retirees, is about 5,000 pesos to 6,000 pesos a month, rising 10% a year through 2027. Average monthly salary credit (AMSC): roughly your average declared salary over your working life, capped by the contribution ceiling. Credited years (CYS): the years SSS has contributions on record for you, not years employed. The minimum pension itself rises in steps, from 1,200 pesos to 2,400 pesos, depending on CYS.

text: Slide to your guess: what is the average monthly SSS retirement pension actually paid today?
spokenText: Slide to your guess: what is the average monthly SSS retirement pension actually paid today?

text: A pension you have not computed is a guess wearing a number.
spokenText: A pension you have not computed is a guess wearing a number.

text: SSS does not pick a formula for you. It computes three and pays whichever gives the most.
spokenText: SSS does not pick a formula for you. It computes three and pays whichever gives the most.

text: Formula (a) rewards years worked. ₱300, plus 20% of AMSC, plus 2% of AMSC for every credited year beyond ten. Formula (a): ₱300 + 20% of AMSC + 2% of AMSC × (CYS − 10). Formula (b): 40% of AMSC, no years needed beyond the minimum ten. Formula (c): the floor, ₱1,200 to ₱2,400 by CYS. Even at ₱45,000 today, AMSC can land near ₱8,000, since it averages decades of contributions, including years when the ceiling was far below today’s ₱35,000.
spokenText: Formula (a) rewards years worked. 300 pesos, plus 20% of AMSC, plus 2% of AMSC for every credited year beyond ten. Formula (a): 300 pesos + 20% of AMSC + 2% of AMSC × (CYS − 10). Formula (b): 40% of AMSC, no years needed beyond the minimum ten. Formula (c): the floor, 1,200 pesos to 2,400 pesos by CYS. Even at 45,000 pesos today, AMSC can land near 8,000 pesos, since it averages decades of contributions, including years when the ceiling was far below today’s 35,000 pesos.

text: AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years. Using formula (a), what is the monthly pension?
spokenText: AMSC 8,000 pesos, 25 credited years. Using formula (a), what is the monthly pension?

text: Every credited year past ten adds 2% of your AMSC to formula (a), for life.
spokenText: Every credited year past ten adds 2% of your AMSC to formula (a), for life.

text: For the same worker, formula (b) and the floor also produce a number. Only one of the three is the pension.
spokenText: For the same worker, formula (b) and the floor also produce a number. Only one of the three is the pension.

text: AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years, gives three candidates. SSS pays the largest. Formula (a): ₱4,300, computed in the last bite. Formula (b), 40% of AMSC: 0.40 × 8,000 = ₱3,200. Formula (c), the floor at 25 years: ₱2,400.
spokenText: AMSC 8,000 pesos, 25 credited years, gives three candidates. SSS pays the largest. Formula (a): 4,300 pesos, computed in the last bite. Formula (b), 40% of AMSC: 0.40 × 8,000 = 3,200 pesos. Formula (c), the floor at 25 years: 2,400 pesos.

text: AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years. Which figure is the actual monthly pension?
spokenText: AMSC 8,000 pesos, 25 credited years. Which figure is the actual monthly pension?

text: Compute all three. The one you expect is not always the one that wins.
spokenText: Compute all three. The one you expect is not always the one that wins.

text: A worker retires with exactly ten credited years, the minimum for a monthly pension at all. Below ten, SSS pays a lump sum instead.
spokenText: A worker retires with exactly ten credited years, the minimum for a monthly pension at all. Below ten, SSS pays a lump sum instead.

text: At exactly ten years, formula (a) has no "beyond ten" years to add, but it can still beat the floor. AMSC ₱6,000: 300 + (0.20 × 6,000) + 0 = ₱1,500, above the ₱1,200 floor for this bracket. The floor is ₱1,200 for ten to nineteen credited years, ₱2,400 for twenty or more. Formula (a) beats the floor even at the ten-year minimum, for most realistic salaries.
spokenText: At exactly ten years, formula (a) has no "beyond ten" years to add, but it can still beat the floor. AMSC 6,000 pesos: 300 + (0.20 × 6,000) + 0 = 1,500 pesos, above the 1,200 pesos floor for this bracket. The floor is 1,200 pesos for ten to nineteen credited years, 2,400 pesos for twenty or more. Formula (a) beats the floor even at the ten-year minimum, for most realistic salaries.

text: Ten years is the minimum for a pension, not for a decent one. The years after that are the ones that matter.
spokenText: Ten years is the minimum for a pension, not for a decent one. The years after that are the ones that matter.

text: A modest retirement still needs about ₱15,000 a month for food, utilities, and medicine. The pension from bite two was ₱4,300.
spokenText: A modest retirement still needs about 15,000 pesos a month for food, utilities, and medicine. The pension from bite two was 4,300 pesos.

text: The gap is what the pension does not cover. It has to come from somewhere else, every month, for as long as retirement lasts. Illustrative monthly needs in retirement: ₱15,000. A twenty-year retirement, from 60 to 80, multiplies a monthly gap into a lifetime one.
spokenText: The gap is what the pension does not cover. It has to come from somewhere else, every month, for as long as retirement lasts. Illustrative monthly needs in retirement: 15,000 pesos. A twenty-year retirement, from 60 to 80, multiplies a monthly gap into a lifetime one.

text: Monthly needs ₱15,000. Monthly pension ₱4,300. What is the monthly gap?
spokenText: Monthly needs 15,000 pesos. Monthly pension 4,300 pesos. What is the monthly gap?

text: Saving ₱5,000 a month with no investment growth would take about forty-three years to close that gap. Fifteen years is what most people in this lesson actually have. The next lessons are about the difference growth makes.
spokenText: Saving 5,000 pesos a month with no investment growth would take about forty-three years to close that gap. Fifteen years is what most people in this lesson actually have. The next lessons are about the difference growth makes.

text: Same person, same ₱10,700 gap, two starting points five years apart.
spokenText: Same person, same 10,700 pesos gap, two starting points five years apart.

text: The formulas in this lesson do not care when you start. The peso total does.
spokenText: The formulas in this lesson do not care when you start. The peso total does.

text: The formula rewards years, not intentions. Five years, either direction, is the whole lesson.
spokenText: The formula rewards years, not intentions. Five years, either direction, is the whole lesson.

text: A ₱150,000 bill at 45 is not the same risk as one at 25. The body changes. The PhilHealth formula does not.
spokenText: A 150,000 pesos bill at 45 is not the same risk as one at 25. The body changes. The PhilHealth formula does not.

text: PhilHealth pays a fixed case rate per condition, not a percentage of the bill. On average it covered about 52% of a hospital bill in 2023, down from 75% in 2018, at any age. The share covered does not rise with your age, and it has been sinking as case rates stay frozen. The bills you are likely to face get larger. Conditions common after 40, heart disease, diabetes complications, cancer, carry higher case rates and higher gaps.
spokenText: PhilHealth pays a fixed case rate per condition, not a percentage of the bill. On average it covered about 52% of a hospital bill in 2023, down from 75% in 2018, at any age. The share covered does not rise with your age, and it has been sinking as case rates stay frozen. The bills you are likely to face get larger. Conditions common after 40, heart disease, diabetes complications, cancer, carry higher case rates and higher gaps.

text: The share is set by the case rate, not by your age, and it is sinking. Plan around what it leaves, not what it covers.
spokenText: The share is set by the case rate, not by your age, and it is sinking. Plan around what it leaves, not what it covers.

text: You earn ₱50,000 a month. The same job, the same HMO card, and a maximum benefit limit that was never explained to shrink.
spokenText: You earn 50,000 pesos a month. The same job, the same HMO card, and a maximum benefit limit that was never explained to shrink.

text: Many employer HMOs reduce the yearly maximum benefit limit, or add a co-payment, once a member passes an age set by the plan, often somewhere in the fifties. Read the fine print now, while you can still act on it. A retiree or resigned employee usually loses the HMO entirely, not just its limit. A personal HMO or health card bought individually costs more with age, and some stop offering new enrolment past a cutoff.
spokenText: Many employer HMOs reduce the yearly maximum benefit limit, or add a co-payment, once a member passes an age set by the plan, often somewhere in the fifties. Read the fine print now, while you can still act on it. A retiree or resigned employee usually loses the HMO entirely, not just its limit. A personal HMO or health card bought individually costs more with age, and some stop offering new enrolment past a cutoff.

text: You turn 55 and your employer HMO’s maximum benefit limit drops under the plan’s age rule. What is the most useful next step?
spokenText: You turn 55 and your employer HMO’s maximum benefit limit drops under the plan’s age rule. What is the most useful next step?

text: The HMO you have at 40 is not the HMO you will have at 60. Read the plan document before it matters.
spokenText: The HMO you have at 40 is not the HMO you will have at 60. Read the plan document before it matters.

text: A colleague survives a heart attack. The hospital bill is covered mostly. The six months away from income is not.
spokenText: A colleague survives a heart attack. The hospital bill is covered mostly. The six months away from income is not.

text: Critical illness cover pays a lump sum on diagnosis of a listed condition, heart attack, cancer, stroke, kidney failure, regardless of the actual hospital bill. It replaces income, not just medical cost.
spokenText: Critical illness cover pays a lump sum on diagnosis of a listed condition, heart attack, cancer, stroke, kidney failure, regardless of the actual hospital bill. It replaces income, not just medical cost.

text: You are 48 with two children still in school. Which protects the household income better if a critical illness strikes?
spokenText: You are 48 with two children still in school. Which protects the household income better if a critical illness strikes?

text: Insurance for this age covers the paycheck, not just the patient.
spokenText: Insurance for this age covers the paycheck, not just the patient.

text: The children’s tuition, a parent’s maintenance medicine, and now a possible hospital bill are all asking for the same peso.
spokenText: The children’s tuition, a parent’s maintenance medicine, and now a possible hospital bill are all asking for the same peso.

text: Size the fund for the gap PhilHealth and the HMO leave, not for the full bill. A serious surgery can run ₱150,000, illustrative. After 55, many households can no longer count on an employer HMO to close the rest of the gap.
spokenText: Size the fund for the gap PhilHealth and the HMO leave, not for the full bill. A serious surgery can run 150,000 pesos, illustrative. After 55, many households can no longer count on an employer HMO to close the rest of the gap.

text: A surgery bill is ₱150,000. PhilHealth covers about 52%. With no HMO to cover the rest, what is the out-of-pocket amount?
spokenText: A surgery bill is 150,000 pesos. PhilHealth covers about 52%. With no HMO to cover the rest, what is the out-of-pocket amount?

text: ₱72,000, reachable in a day, insured, separate from the general fund.
spokenText: 72,000 pesos, reachable in a day, insured, separate from the general fund.

text: The phone rings during a work call. Your mother has been admitted. You will decide what to do before you know the full bill.
spokenText: The phone rings during a work call. Your mother has been admitted. You will decide what to do before you know the full bill.

text: A parent’s illness rarely announces its price in advance. The fund exists so the first decision is not about money.
spokenText: A parent’s illness rarely announces its price in advance. The fund exists so the first decision is not about money.

text: A fund at the ready removes the two hours you cannot get back at an admission desk.
spokenText: A fund at the ready removes the two hours you cannot get back at an admission desk.

text: The pension from the last lesson was ₱4,300, and the gap was ₱10,700 a month. SSS has a second, voluntary account meant to close part of that.
spokenText: The pension from the last lesson was 4,300 pesos, and the gap was 10,700 pesos a month. SSS has a second, voluntary account meant to close part of that.

text: Pension Booster is a voluntary SSS contribution, minimum ₱500 a month, separate from the regular contribution the formula uses. It grows tax-free and is paid out on top of the regular pension. Regular SSS contributions decide the pension from the last lesson. Booster is a second, optional contribution on top of that. Minimum ₱500 a month. There is no formula to compute here; whatever is put in grows tax-free until retirement.
spokenText: Pension Booster is a voluntary SSS contribution, minimum 500 pesos a month, separate from the regular contribution the formula uses. It grows tax-free and is paid out on top of the regular pension. Regular SSS contributions decide the pension from the last lesson. Booster is a second, optional contribution on top of that. Minimum 500 pesos a month. There is no formula to compute here; whatever is put in grows tax-free until retirement.

text: You already have the pension the formula computes. What does Pension Booster do?
spokenText: You already have the pension the formula computes. What does Pension Booster do?

text: Booster does not fix the formula. It sits beside it.
spokenText: Booster does not fix the formula. It sits beside it.

text: PERA is a second voluntary account, run through an accredited administrator rather than SSS directly. It pays something Booster does not: cash back at tax time.
spokenText: PERA is a second voluntary account, run through an accredited administrator rather than SSS directly. It pays something Booster does not: cash back at tax time.

text: Every peso put into PERA earns a 5% tax credit, on top of tax-free growth on the investment itself. The credit is separate money, paid regardless of how the investment performs. The credit is 5% of what is contributed for the year, not 5% of any gain. The annual cap is ₱200,000 in contributions for most members and ₱400,000 for OFWs, doubled by the 2025 Capital Markets Efficiency Promotion Act.
spokenText: Every peso put into PERA earns a 5% tax credit, on top of tax-free growth on the investment itself. The credit is separate money, paid regardless of how the investment performs. The credit is 5% of what is contributed for the year, not 5% of any gain. The annual cap is 200,000 pesos in contributions for most members and 400,000 pesos for OFWs, doubled by the 2025 Capital Markets Efficiency Promotion Act.

text: You contribute ₱5,000 a month to PERA, ₱60,000 for the year. At 5%, what tax credit do you receive?
spokenText: You contribute 5,000 pesos a month to PERA, 60,000 pesos for the year. At 5%, what tax credit do you receive?

text: ₱3,000 back on ₱60,000 contributed is money Booster does not pay.
spokenText: 3,000 pesos back on 60,000 pesos contributed is money Booster does not pay.

text: Both accounts grow tax-free. Only one pays a credit for showing up at all.
spokenText: Both accounts grow tax-free. Only one pays a credit for showing up at all.

text: Booster stays inside the SSS account the member already has. PERA needs a separate account with an accredited administrator, who invests the money in a fund the member chooses.

text: A will decides who administers the estate and how it is divided. Without one, the law’s default order of heirs applies, whether the estate is large or small, and settling still takes time and paperwork either way. A will can be notarial, witnessed and notarised, or holographic, entirely handwritten, dated, and signed. Size does not decide whether a will is needed. Having dependents and property, even modest ones, does.

text: Binabayad ng SSS ang pinakamataas sa tatlong formula, mula sa average monthly salary credit mo at credited years mo. Ang resulta, para sa karamihan, ay mga ₱5,000 hanggang ₱6,000 kada buwan, tumataas ng 10% kada taon hanggang 2027. Average monthly salary credit (AMSC): humigit-kumulang ang average ng idineklarang sweldo mo sa buong trabaho, may takda mula sa contribution ceiling. Credited years (CYS): ang mga taon na may contributions sa record ng SSS, hindi ang taon na empleyado ka. Tumataas din ang minimum pension, mula ₱1,200 hanggang ₱2,400, depende sa CYS.

Credited years (CYS): ang mga taon na may contributions sa record ng SSS, hindi ang taon na empleyado ka. Tumataas din ang minimum pension, mula one thousand two hundred pesos hanggang two thousand four hundred pesos, depende sa CYS.

text: I-slide ang hula mo: magkano ang average monthly SSS retirement pension na binabayad ngayon?
spokenText: I-slide ang hula mo: magkano ang average monthly SSS retirement pension na binabayad ngayon?

text: Ang pension na hindi mo pa nakwenta ay hula na may nakasuot na numero.
spokenText: Ang pension na hindi mo pa nakwenta ay hula na may nakasuot na numero.

text: Hindi pumipili ng formula ang SSS para sa iyo. Kinukwenta nito ang tatlo at binabayad ang pinakamalaki.
spokenText: Hindi pumipili ng formula ang SSS para sa iyo. Kinukwenta nito ang tatlo at binabayad ang pinakamalaki.

text: Ginagantimpalaan ng formula (a) ang bawat taon ng pagtatrabaho. ₱300, dagdag 20% ng AMSC, dagdag 2% ng AMSC kada credited year lampas sa sampu. Formula (a): ₱300 + 20% ng AMSC + 2% ng AMSC × (CYS − 10). Formula (b): 40% ng AMSC, walang kailangang taon lampas sa minimum na sampu. Formula (c): ang floor, ₱1,200 hanggang ₱2,400 ayon sa CYS. Kahit ₱45,000 ngayon, puwedeng malapit sa ₱8,000 ang AMSC, dahil average ito ng dekada ng contributions, kasama ang mga taong mas mababa pa ang ceiling kaysa ₱35,000 ngayon.
spokenText: Ginagantimpalaan ng formula (a) ang bawat taon ng pagtatrabaho. three hundred pesos, dagdag twenty percent ng AMSC, dagdag two percent ng AMSC kada credited year lampas sa sampu. Formula (a): three hundred pesos + twenty percent ng AMSC + two percent ng AMSC × (CYS − ten). Formula (b): forty percent ng AMSC, walang kailangang taon lampas sa minimum na sampu. Formula (c): ang floor, one thousand two hundred pesos hanggang two thousand four hundred pesos ayon sa CYS. Kahit forty-five thousand pesos ngayon, puwedeng malapit sa eight thousand pesos ang AMSC, dahil average ito ng dekada ng contributions, kasama ang mga taong mas mababa pa ang ceiling kaysa thirty-five thousand pesos ngayon.

text: AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years. Gamit ang formula (a), magkano ang buwanang pension?
spokenText: AMSC eight thousand pesos, twenty-five credited years. Gamit ang formula (a), magkano ang buwanang pension?

text: Bawat credited year lampas sa sampu ay nagdaragdag ng 2% ng AMSC mo sa formula (a), habambuhay.
spokenText: Bawat credited year lampas sa sampu ay nagdaragdag ng two percent ng AMSC mo sa formula (a), habambuhay.

text: Para sa parehong manggagawa, may numero rin ang formula (b) at ang floor. Isa lang sa tatlo ang siyang pension.
spokenText: Para sa parehong manggagawa, may numero rin ang formula (b) at ang floor. Isa lang sa tatlo ang siyang pension.

text: Ang AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years, ay may tatlong kandidato. Binabayad ng SSS ang pinakamalaki. Formula (a): ₱4,300, kinwenta sa nakaraang bite. Formula (b), 40% ng AMSC: 0.40 × 8,000 = ₱3,200. Formula (c), ang floor sa 25 taon: ₱2,400.
spokenText: Ang AMSC eight thousand pesos, twenty-five credited years, ay may tatlong kandidato. Binabayad ng SSS ang pinakamalaki. Formula (a): four thousand three hundred pesos, kinwenta sa nakaraang bite. Formula (b), forty percent ng AMSC: zero point four zero × eight thousand = three thousand two hundred pesos. Formula (c), ang floor sa twenty-five taon: two thousand four hundred pesos.

text: AMSC ₱8,000, 25 credited years. Alin ang talagang buwanang pension?
spokenText: AMSC eight thousand pesos, twenty-five credited years. Alin ang talagang buwanang pension?

text: Kwentahin ang tatlo. Hindi laging ang inaasahan mo ang panalo.
spokenText: Kwentahin ang tatlo. Hindi laging ang inaasahan mo ang panalo.

text: May manggagawang nag-retire na eksaktong sampung credited years lang, ang minimum para may buwanang pension. Sa ilalim ng sampu, lump sum ang binabayad ng SSS.
spokenText: May manggagawang nag-retire na eksaktong sampung credited years lang, ang minimum para may buwanang pension. Sa ilalim ng sampu, lump sum ang binabayad ng SSS.

text: Sa eksaktong sampung taon, walang "lampas sa sampu" na taon na maidadagdag sa formula (a), pero puwede pa rin itong tumalo sa floor. AMSC ₱6,000: 300 + (0.20 × 6,000) + 0 = ₱1,500, mas mataas sa ₱1,200 floor ng bracket na ito. Ang floor ay ₱1,200 sa sampu hanggang labinsiyam na credited years, ₱2,400 sa dalawampu pataas. Tinatalo ng formula (a) ang floor kahit sa sampung-taong minimum, para sa karamihan ng makatotohanang sweldo.
spokenText: Sa eksaktong sampung taon, walang "lampas sa sampu" na taon na maidadagdag sa formula (a), pero puwede pa rin itong tumalo sa floor. AMSC six thousand pesos: three hundred + (zero point two zero × six thousand) + zero = one thousand five hundred pesos, mas mataas sa one thousand two hundred pesos floor ng bracket na ito. Ang floor ay one thousand two hundred pesos sa sampu hanggang labinsiyam na credited years, two thousand four hundred pesos sa dalawampu pataas. Tinatalo ng formula (a) ang floor kahit sa sampung-taong minimum, para sa karamihan ng makatotohanang sweldo.

text: Ang sampung taon ang minimum para sa pension, hindi para sa disenteng pension. Ang mga taon pagkatapos noon ang mahalaga.
spokenText: Ang sampung taon ang minimum para sa pension, hindi para sa disenteng pension. Ang mga taon pagkatapos noon ang mahalaga.

text: Ang simpleng retirement ay nangangailangan pa rin ng mga ₱15,000 kada buwan para sa pagkain, kuryente, at gamot. ₱4,300 ang pension mula sa bite two.
spokenText: Ang simpleng retirement ay nangangailangan pa rin ng mga fifteen thousand pesos kada buwan para sa pagkain, kuryente, at gamot. four thousand three hundred pesos ang pension mula sa bite two.

text: Ang puwang ay ang hindi sakop ng pension. Kailangan itong manggaling sa iba, bawat buwan, habang tumatagal ang retirement. Illustrative na buwanang needs sa retirement: ₱15,000. Ang dalawampung-taong retirement, mula 60 hanggang 80, ay pinaparami ang buwanang puwang sa habambuhay na puwang.
spokenText: Ang puwang ay ang hindi sakop ng pension. Kailangan itong manggaling sa iba, bawat buwan, habang tumatagal ang retirement. Illustrative na buwanang needs sa retirement: fifteen thousand pesos. Ang dalawampung-taong retirement, mula sixty hanggang eighty, ay pinaparami ang buwanang puwang sa habambuhay na puwang.

text: Buwanang needs ₱15,000. Buwanang pension ₱4,300. Ano ang buwanang puwang?
spokenText: Buwanang needs fifteen thousand pesos. Buwanang pension four thousand three hundred pesos. Ano ang buwanang puwang?

text: Ang pag-ipon ng ₱5,000 kada buwan nang walang investment growth ay aabot ng mga apatnapu’t tatlong taon para punan ang puwang. Labinlimang taon ang totoong meron ang karamihan sa lesson na ito. Ang susunod na mga lesson ay tungkol sa pagkakaiba ng growth.
spokenText: Ang pag-ipon ng five thousand pesos kada buwan nang walang investment growth ay aabot ng mga apatnapu’t tatlong taon para punan ang puwang. Labinlimang taon ang totoong meron ang karamihan sa lesson na ito. Ang susunod na mga lesson ay tungkol sa pagkakaiba ng growth.

text: Parehong tao, parehong ₱10,700 na puwang, dalawang simula na limang taon ang layo.
spokenText: Parehong tao, parehong ten thousand seven hundred pesos na puwang, dalawang simula na limang taon ang layo.

text: Walang pakialam ang mga formula sa lesson na ito kung kailan ka magsisimula. Pero may pakialam ang kabuuang piso.
spokenText: Walang pakialam ang mga formula sa lesson na ito kung kailan ka magsisimula. Pero may pakialam ang kabuuang piso.

text: Gantimpala ng formula ang taon, hindi intensyon. Limang taon, kahit saang direksyon, iyon na ang buong lesson.
spokenText: Gantimpala ng formula ang taon, hindi intensyon. Limang taon, kahit saang direksyon, iyon na ang buong lesson.

text: Iba ang risk ng ₱150,000 na bill sa edad na 45 kumpara sa 25. Nagbabago ang katawan. Hindi nagbabago ang formula ng PhilHealth.
spokenText: Iba ang risk ng one hundred fifty thousand pesos na bill sa edad na forty-five kumpara sa twenty-five. Nagbabago ang katawan. Hindi nagbabago ang formula ng PhilHealth.

text: Nagbabayad ang PhilHealth ng fixed case rate kada kondisyon, hindi porsyento ng bill. Sa average, mga 52% ng hospital bill noong 2023, mula 75% noong 2018, kahit anong edad. Hindi tumataas ang share na sakop dahil sa edad, at lumiliit pa ito habang nakapirmi ang case rates. Lumalaki ang mga bill na malamang harapin mo. Ang mga kondisyong karaniwan pagkalampas ng 40, sakit sa puso, komplikasyon ng diabetes, cancer, ay may mas mataas na case rate at mas malaking puwang.
spokenText: Nagbabayad ang PhilHealth ng fixed case rate kada kondisyon, hindi porsyento ng bill. Sa average, mga fifty-two percent ng hospital bill noong two thousand twenty-three, mula seventy-five percent noong two thousand eighteen, kahit anong edad. Hindi tumataas ang share na sakop dahil sa edad, at lumiliit pa ito habang nakapirmi ang case rates. Lumalaki ang mga bill na malamang harapin mo. Ang mga kondisyong karaniwan pagkalampas ng forty, sakit sa puso, komplikasyon ng diabetes, cancer, ay may mas mataas na case rate at mas malaking puwang.

text: Nakatakda ang share sa case rate, hindi sa edad mo, at lumiliit ito. Magplano base sa natitira, hindi sa sakop.
spokenText: Nakatakda ang share sa case rate, hindi sa edad mo, at lumiliit ito. Magplano base sa natitira, hindi sa sakop.

text: Kumikita ka ng ₱50,000 kada buwan. Parehong trabaho, parehong HMO card, at maximum benefit limit na hindi ipinaliwanag na lumiliit.
spokenText: Kumikita ka ng fifty thousand pesos kada buwan. Parehong trabaho, parehong HMO card, at maximum benefit limit na hindi ipinaliwanag na lumiliit.

text: Maraming employer HMO ang binabawasan ang taunang maximum benefit limit, o nagdaragdag ng co-payment, kapag lumampas na ang miyembro sa edad na itinakda ng plano, madalas sa kalagitnaan ng fifties. Basahin ang fine print ngayon, habang may magagawa ka pa. Karaniwang nawawala ang buong HMO, hindi lang ang limit, kapag nag-retire o nag-resign. Mas mahal ang personal na HMO o health card na binili nang mag-isa habang tumatanda, at may mga hindi na tumatanggap ng bagong miyembro lampas sa cutoff.
spokenText: Maraming employer HMO ang binabawasan ang taunang maximum benefit limit, o nagdaragdag ng co-payment, kapag lumampas na ang miyembro sa edad na itinakda ng plano, madalas sa kalagitnaan ng fifties. Basahin ang fine print ngayon, habang may magagawa ka pa. Karaniwang nawawala ang buong HMO, hindi lang ang limit, kapag nag-retire o nag-resign. Mas mahal ang personal na HMO o health card na binili nang mag-isa habang tumatanda, at may mga hindi na tumatanggap ng bagong miyembro lampas sa cutoff.

text: Nag-55 ka at bumaba ang maximum benefit limit ng employer HMO mo dahil sa age rule ng plano. Ano ang pinaka-makatutulong na susunod na hakbang?
spokenText: Nag-fifty-five ka at bumaba ang maximum benefit limit ng employer HMO mo dahil sa age rule ng plano. Ano ang pinaka-makatutulong na susunod na hakbang?

text: Ang HMO mo sa 40 ay hindi ang HMO mo sa 60. Basahin ang plan document bago ito maging importante.
spokenText: Ang HMO mo sa forty ay hindi ang HMO mo sa sixty. Basahin ang plan document bago ito maging importante.

text: Nabuhay ang katrabaho pagkatapos ng heart attack. Halos sakop ang hospital bill. Hindi sakop ang anim na buwang wala sa trabaho.
spokenText: Nabuhay ang katrabaho pagkatapos ng heart attack. Halos sakop ang hospital bill. Hindi sakop ang anim na buwang wala sa trabaho.

text: Nagbabayad ang critical illness cover ng lump sum pag-diagnose ng listadong kondisyon, heart attack, cancer, stroke, kidney failure, kahit ano ang aktwal na hospital bill. Pinapalitan nito ang kita, hindi lang ang gastos sa medikal.
spokenText: Nagbabayad ang critical illness cover ng lump sum pag-diagnose ng listadong kondisyon, heart attack, cancer, stroke, kidney failure, kahit ano ang aktwal na hospital bill. Pinapalitan nito ang kita, hindi lang ang gastos sa medikal.

text: 48 ka na may dalawang anak na nag-aaral pa. Alin ang mas mabuting proteksyon sa kita ng pamilya kung tumama ang critical illness?
spokenText: forty-eight ka na may dalawang anak na nag-aaral pa. Alin ang mas mabuting proteksyon sa kita ng pamilya kung tumama ang critical illness?

text: Ang insurance sa edad na ito ay sakop ang sweldo, hindi lang ang pasyente.
spokenText: Ang insurance sa edad na ito ay sakop ang sweldo, hindi lang ang pasyente.

spokenText: Ang tuition ng mga anak, gamot ng magulang, at posibleng hospital bill ay parehong humihingi ng parehong piso.

text: Sukatin ang fund para sa puwang na iniwan ng PhilHealth at HMO, hindi para sa buong bill. Ang seryosong surgery ay puwedeng umabot ng ₱150,000, illustrative. Pagkalampas ng 55, marami nang sambahayan ang hindi na maaasahan sa employer HMO para punan ang natitira.
spokenText: Sukatin ang fund para sa puwang na iniwan ng PhilHealth at HMO, hindi para sa buong bill. Ang seryosong surgery ay puwedeng umabot ng one hundred fifty thousand pesos, illustrative. text: ₱150,000 ang surgery bill. Mga 52% ang sakop ng PhilHealth. Walang HMO na sasakop sa natitira, magkano ang out-of-pocket?
spokenText: one hundred fifty thousand pesos ang surgery bill. Mga fifty-two percent ang sakop ng PhilHealth. Walang HMO na sasakop sa natitira, magkano ang out-of-pocket?

text: ₱72,000, maaabot sa isang araw, insured, hiwalay sa general fund.
spokenText: seventy-two thousand pesos, maaabot sa isang araw, insured, hiwalay sa general fund.

text: Tumunog ang phone habang may work call. Na-admit ang nanay mo. Magdedesisyon ka bago mo pa malaman ang buong bill.
spokenText: Tumunog ang phone habang may work call. Na-admit ang nanay mo. Magdedesisyon ka bago mo pa malaman ang buong bill.

text: Bihirang malaman agad ang magiging presyo ng sakit ng isang magulang. Ang fund ay para sa unang desisyon na hindi tungkol sa pera.
spokenText: Bihirang malaman agad ang magiging presyo ng sakit ng isang magulang. Ang fund ay para sa unang desisyon na hindi tungkol sa pera.

spokenText: Ang fund na handa ay inaalis ang dalawang oras na hindi mo na mababawi sa admission desk.

text: ₱4,300 ang pension mula sa nakaraang lesson, at ₱10,700 ang puwang kada buwan. May pangalawa, voluntary na account ang SSS na para punan ang bahagi niyon.
spokenText: four thousand three hundred pesos ang pension mula sa nakaraang lesson, at ten thousand seven hundred pesos ang puwang kada buwan. May pangalawa, voluntary na account ang SSS na para punan ang bahagi niyon.

text: Ang Pension Booster ay voluntary na contribution sa SSS, minimum ₱500 kada buwan, hiwalay sa regular contribution na ginagamit ng formula. Tax-free ang paglaki nito at binabayad bilang dagdag sa regular na pension. Ang regular SSS contributions ang nagdedesisyon sa pension mula sa nakaraang lesson. Ang Booster ay pangalawa, optional na contribution na dagdag doon. Minimum ₱500 kada buwan. Walang formula na kwentahan dito; lumalaki nang tax-free ang anumang inilagay hanggang retirement.
spokenText: Ang Pension Booster ay voluntary na contribution sa SSS, minimum five hundred pesos kada buwan, hiwalay sa regular contribution na ginagamit ng formula. Tax-free ang paglaki nito at binabayad bilang dagdag sa regular na pension. Ang regular SSS contributions ang nagdedesisyon sa pension mula sa nakaraang lesson. Ang Booster ay pangalawa, optional na contribution na dagdag doon. Minimum five hundred pesos kada buwan. Walang formula na kwentahan dito; lumalaki nang tax-free ang anumang inilagay hanggang retirement.

text: Meron ka nang pension na kinukwenta ng formula. Ano ang ginagawa ng Pension Booster?
spokenText: Meron ka nang pension na kinukwenta ng formula. Ano ang ginagawa ng Pension Booster?

text: Hindi inaayos ng Booster ang formula. Katabi lang ito nito.

text: Ang PERA ay pangalawang voluntary account, sa pamamagitan ng accredited administrator, hindi direkta sa SSS. May binabayad itong hindi kaya ng Booster: cash back sa tax time.
spokenText: Ang PERA ay pangalawang voluntary account, sa pamamagitan ng accredited administrator, hindi direkta sa SSS. May binabayad itong hindi kaya ng Booster: cash back sa tax time.

text: Bawat piso na inilagay sa PERA ay may 5% tax credit, dagdag pa sa tax-free growth ng investment mismo. Hiwalay na pera ang credit, binabayad kahit ano ang performance ng investment. Ang credit ay 5% ng inilagay sa loob ng taon, hindi 5% ng anumang gain. Ang taunang cap ay ₱200,000 sa contributions para sa karamihan at ₱400,000 para sa OFW, dinoble ng 2025 Capital Markets Efficiency Promotion Act.
spokenText: Bawat piso na inilagay sa PERA ay may five percent tax credit, dagdag pa sa tax-free growth ng investment mismo. Hiwalay na pera ang credit, binabayad kahit ano ang performance ng investment. Ang credit ay five percent ng inilagay sa loob ng taon, hindi five percent ng anumang gain. Ang taunang cap ay two hundred thousand pesos sa contributions para sa karamihan at four hundred thousand pesos para sa OFW, dinoble ng two thousand twenty-five Capital Markets Efficiency Promotion Act.

text: Nag-contribute ka ng ₱5,000 kada buwan sa PERA, ₱60,000 sa buong taon. Sa 5%, magkano ang tax credit mo?
spokenText: Nag-contribute ka ng five thousand pesos kada buwan sa PERA, sixty thousand pesos sa buong taon. Sa five percent, magkano ang tax credit mo?

text: ₱3,000 na balik sa ₱60,000 na kontribusyon ay perang hindi binabayad ng Booster.
spokenText: three thousand pesos na balik sa sixty thousand pesos na kontribusyon ay perang hindi binabayad ng Booster.

text: Parehong tax-free ang paglaki. Isa lang ang may binabayad na credit sa pagpasok mo pa lang.
spokenText: Parehong tax-free ang paglaki. Isa lang ang may binabayad na credit sa pagpasok mo pa lang.

text: Nananatili ang Booster sa loob ng SSS account na meron na ang miyembro. Kailangan ng PERA ng hiwalay na account sa accredited administrator, na siyang mag-iinvest sa fund na pinili ng miyembro.
spokenText: Nananatili ang Booster sa loob ng SSS account na meron na ang miyembro. Kailangan ng PERA ng hiwalay na account sa accredited administrator, na siyang mag-iinvest sa fund na pinili ng miyembro.

text: Parehong ₱5,000 kada buwan. Alin ang mas mataas ang bayad para sa contribution lang?
spokenText: Parehong five thousand pesos kada buwan. Alin ang mas mataas ang bayad para sa contribution lang?

text: Ang credit ang bentahe ng PERA. Ang paperwork ang presyo nito.
spokenText: Ang credit ang bentahe ng PERA. Ang paperwork ang presyo nito.

text: Simula Hulyo 2025, mas malaking deduction ang employer na nag-a-contribute sa PERA ng manggagawa. May mga terminong dapat malaman bago tanungin ang HR.
spokenText: Simula Hulyo two thousand twenty-five, mas malaking deduction ang employer na nag-a-contribute sa PERA ng manggagawa. May mga terminong dapat malaman bago tanungin ang HR.

text: Sa RA 12214, puwedeng i-deduct ng employer ang 150% ng kontribusyon nito sa PERA ng empleyado mula sa sariling taxable income. Mas mababa ang tax cost sa employer na pondohan ang retirement account ng manggagawa kaysa ibigay ang parehong piso bilang sweldo.
spokenText: Sa RA twelve thousand two hundred fourteen, puwedeng i-deduct ng employer ang one hundred fifty percent ng kontribusyon nito sa PERA ng empleyado mula sa sariling taxable income. text: Ang manggagawang nagtatanong tungkol sa PERA match ay humihingi ng bagay na pinapaboran na rin ng sariling tax return ng employer.
spokenText: Ang manggagawang nagtatanong tungkol sa PERA match ay humihingi ng bagay na pinapaboran na rin ng sariling tax return ng employer.

text: Parehong ₱5,000 kada buwan, labinlimang taon bago mag-60. Ang pagpipilian ay Pension Booster o PERA. Ang mas malaking tanong ay kung magagamit nang buo ang labinlimang taon.
spokenText: Parehong five thousand pesos kada buwan, labinlimang taon bago mag-sixty. Ang pagpipilian ay Pension Booster o PERA. Ang mas malaking tanong ay kung magagamit nang buo ang labinlimang taon.

text: Parehong account dito ay illustrative sa steady na 6%. Ang mas malaking nagbabago sa huling balance ay hindi ang pinili mong account, kundi kung tumakbo ito ng buong labinlimang taon.

text: Booster man o PERA, ₱5,000 kada buwan sa loob ng labinlimang taon ay umaabot sa halos parehong numero. Pareho ang gastos ng maagang paghinto, kahit anong account ang may hawak nito.
spokenText: Booster man o PERA, five thousand pesos kada buwan sa loob ng labinlimang taon ay umaabot sa halos parehong numero. Pareho ang gastos ng maagang paghinto, kahit anong account ang may hawak nito.

text: Sa edad 50, naglagay ka ng ₱300,000 sa isang MP2 account. Sa 53, may emergency na kailangan ng ₱100,000 mula rito.
spokenText: Sa edad fifty, naglagay ka ng three hundred thousand pesos sa isang MP2 account. Sa fifty-three, may emergency na kailangan ng one hundred thousand pesos mula rito.

text: Ang MP2 ay limang-taong term account, dividend na 7.12% para sa 2025, minimum ₱500 kada buwan. Ang iisang tranche ay naka-lock sa loob ng buong limang taon, hindi bahagi lang nito. Isang tranche, isang maturity date. Nananatili sa loob ang anumang laman hanggang sa petsang iyon. Ang ladder ng mas maliliit na tranches, binuksan sa magkakaibang taon, ay ikinakalat ang maturity dates sa halip na patungin ang lahat sa isang araw.
spokenText: Ang MP2 ay limang-taong term account, dividend na seven point one two percent para sa two thousand twenty-five, minimum five hundred pesos kada buwan. text: Naglagay ka ng ₱300,000 sa isang MP2 account sa edad 50. Sa 53, may emergency na kailangan ng ₱100,000. Ano ang kaya mong ilabas mula sa account na iyon?
spokenText: Naglagay ka ng three hundred thousand pesos sa isang MP2 account sa edad fifty. Sa fifty-three, may emergency na kailangan ng one hundred thousand pesos. Ano ang kaya mong ilabas mula sa account na iyon?

text: Ang isang MP2 tranche ay isang malaking lock. Ang ladder ay maraming maliliit na lock.
spokenText: Ang isang MP2 tranche ay isang malaking lock. Ang ladder ay maraming maliliit na lock.

text: Ang solusyon sa problema ng nakaraang bite ay hindi mas malaking emergency fund. Ito ay ibang paraan ng pagbukas ng MP2 mula sa simula.
spokenText: Ang solusyon sa problema ng nakaraang bite ay hindi mas malaking emergency fund. Ito ay ibang paraan ng pagbukas ng MP2 mula sa simula.

text: Ang ladder ay nagbubukas ng bagong MP2 tranche bawat taon sa halip na isang lump sum. Pagkatapos ng limang taon, may nag-mamature na tranche bawat taon mula noon. Ang bawat tranche ay kailangan lang ng minimum ₱500 kada buwan o higit pa para mabuksan. Sa ikalimang taon, limang tranches na ang bukas, magkakalayo ng isang taon sa isa't isa.
spokenText: Ang ladder ay nagbubukas ng bagong MP2 tranche bawat taon sa halip na isang lump sum. Pagkatapos ng limang taon, may nag-mamature na tranche bawat taon mula noon. text: Ayusin ang mga hakbang sa paggawa ng MP2 ladder.
spokenText: Ayusin ang mga hakbang sa paggawa ng MP2 ladder.

text: Hindi kailangan ng ladder ang lump sum. Kailangan nito ng bagong tranche bawat taon.

text: Hindi kailangan ng ladder ang Retail Treasury Bond. Nagbabayad ito ng fixed rate, sa fixed na schedule, sa buong limang-taong term nito.

text: Dumating ang mid-year bonus na ₱50,000. Hindi katulad ng buwanang sweldo, hindi ito kailangang pumili ng isang goal kaysa sa isa; puwede nitong pondohan ang dalawa nang sabay.

text: Magsisimula sa unibersidad ang anak mo ngayong taon, ₱150,000 kada taon ang tuition, illustrative para sa 2030. ₱5,000 kada buwan ang Booster contribution. Ngayong taon, hindi sapat para sa dalawa nang buo.

text: Ang sambahayang may bayad-nang bahay, katamtamang savings, at walang ibang property ay parang ordinaryo lang. Ito mismo ang estate na para sa will.
spokenText: Ang sambahayang may bayad-nang bahay, katamtamang savings, at walang ibang property ay parang ordinaryo lang. Ito mismo ang estate na para sa will.

text: Nagdedesisyon ang will kung sino ang mangangasiwa sa estate at paano ito hahatiin. Kung wala, ang default order of heirs ng batas ang magagamit, malaki man o maliit ang estate, at kailangan pa rin ng oras at papeles para maayos ito. Ang will ay puwedeng notarial, may witness at notarized, o holographic, buong sulat-kamay, may petsa, at pirmado. Hindi ang laki ang nagdedesisyon kung kailangan ng will. Ang pagkakaroon ng dependents at property, kahit katamtaman, ang nagdedesisyon.

spokenText: May five million pesos na standard deduction na aplikable sa bawat estate. Hiwalay na exempt ang family home hanggang ten million pesos. text: SSS pays a 13th month pension every December, the same as one month’s pension, with no application needed. spokenText: Which costs less: 200,000 pesos given now, or 200,000 pesos left in the estate?

text: A written gift now can cost nothing in tax and avoid a dispute later.
spokenText: A written gift now can cost nothing in tax and avoid a dispute later.

text: Grandma passes away. Her joint account with her daughter freezes the next morning.
spokenText: Grandma passes away. Her joint account with her daughter freezes the next morning.

text: A bank freezes a deceased owner’s accounts, joint ones included, until estate tax clearance.
spokenText: A bank freezes a deceased owner’s accounts, joint ones included, until estate tax clearance.

text: A joint name does not skip the freeze. File the estate tax early.
spokenText: A joint name does not skip the freeze. File the estate tax early.

text: A nephew calls with an emergency, again. You have not decided your limit yet.
spokenText: A nephew calls with an emergency, again. You have not decided your limit yet.

text: A fixed monthly amount you can afford is a gift, decided before anyone asks. Decide the number on a calm day, not during a call. A number said kindly is easier to hear than a yes you regret.
spokenText: A fixed monthly amount you can afford is a gift, decided before anyone asks. Decide the number on a calm day, not during a call. A number said kindly is easier to hear than a yes you regret.

text: Your monthly income is ₱10,000. What is a fair limit for helping family?
spokenText: Your monthly income is 10,000 pesos. What is a fair limit for helping family?

text: Decide the number before anyone calls. Say it kindly when they do.
spokenText: Decide the number before anyone calls. Say it kindly when they do.

text: Your son asks you to open a lending app account. He says he will pay it back.
spokenText: Your son asks you to open a lending app account. He says he will pay it back.

text: A loan taken in your name is your debt, no matter who promised to pay. The lender will collect from you, not from your son. A missed payment can affect your name in a credit report.

text: Your son asks you to open a lending app in your name for him. What should you do?
spokenText: Your son asks you to open a lending app in your name for him. What should you do?

text: Never take a loan in your own name for someone else.
spokenText: Never take a loan in your own name for someone else.

text: ₱9,000 comes in this month. A daughter overseas, a grandchild at home, both need something.
spokenText: 9,000 pesos comes in this month. A daughter overseas, a grandchild at home, both need something.

text: Split what you can spare, needs first, before deciding the remittance amount.

text: Split ₱9,000: your needs, your remittance, and savings.
spokenText: Split 9,000 pesos: your needs, your remittance, and savings.

text: The remittance is what is left after your own needs, not before.
spokenText: The remittance is what is left after your own needs, not before.

text: A grandson asks for ₱5,000 for a “sure win” bet. Saying no feels hard.
spokenText: A grandson asks for 5,000 pesos for a “sure win” bet. Saying no feels hard.

text: Some requests deserve a fixed remittance. Others deserve a kind no with a number.
spokenText: Some requests deserve a fixed remittance. Others deserve a kind no with a number.

text: Sort each request. Left gets help, right gets a kind no.
spokenText: Sort each request. Left gets help, right gets a kind no.

text: A no with a number is kinder than a yes that empties your cash.
spokenText: A no with a number is kinder than a yes that empties your cash.

text: A daughter asks for ₱3,000 again, the third time this month.
spokenText: A daughter asks for 3,000 pesos again, the third time this month.

text: A pattern of asking can quietly empty the cash bucket meant for a year.
spokenText: A pattern of asking can quietly empty the cash bucket meant for a year.

text: A number said kindly protects both the bucket and the relationship.
spokenText: A number said kindly protects both the bucket and the relationship.

text: Every lesson here uses a monthly income of ₱5,000 to ₱15,000. That is pension, savings, and family support combined. Your own numbers replace it wherever Jinnie has them.
spokenText: Every lesson here uses a monthly income of 5,000 pesos to 15,000 pesos. That is pension, savings, and family support combined. Your own numbers replace it wherever Jinnie has them.

text: Nag-sisenta na po kayo. Tumigil na kayo sa pagtatrabaho. Sabi ng kapitbahay, kailangan pa raw ninyong maghintay hanggang sesenta-singko.
spokenText: Nag-sisenta na po kayo. Tumigil na kayo sa pagtatrabaho. Sabi ng kapitbahay, kailangan pa raw ninyong maghintay hanggang sesenta-singko.

text: Puwede na po kayong mag-retire sa animnapu, kung tumigil na kayo sa trabaho. Compulsory pa rin ito sa animnapu’t lima, kahit ano pa ang trabaho ninyo. Sa 60: optional po, kung tumigil na kayo sa trabaho o negosyo. Sa 65: compulsory po, kahit nagtatrabaho pa kayo. Kapag maaga kayong nag-claim sa 60, mas maliit ang pension ninyo habambuhay.
spokenText: Puwede na po kayong mag-retire sa animnapu, kung tumigil na kayo sa trabaho. Compulsory pa rin ito sa animnapu’t lima, kahit ano pa ang trabaho ninyo. text: Animnapu na po kayo at hindi na nagtatrabaho. Kailan po kayo puwedeng mag-claim ng SSS pension?
spokenText: Animnapu na po kayo at hindi na nagtatrabaho. Kailan po kayo puwedeng mag-claim ng SSS pension?

text: Pagpipilian ang animnapu, hindi patakaran. Kayo po ang magpapasya kung kailan titigil.
spokenText: Pagpipilian ang animnapu, hindi patakaran. Kayo po ang magpapasya kung kailan titigil.

text: Dalawang kapitbahay, parehong buwan silang nag-65. Isa, may pension habambuhay. Isa, minsanang bayad na lang.
spokenText: Dalawang kapitbahay, parehong buwan silang nag-sixty-five. Isa, may pension habambuhay. Isa, minsanang bayad na lang.

text: Kailangan ng hindi bababa sa 120 monthly contributions para sa buwanang pension habambuhay. Kulang dito, lump sum na lang ang ibibigay ng SSS. Sampung taon ng pagbabayad ang 120 contributions, kahit anong pagkakasunod. May sariling patakaran ang GSIS. Magtanong po sa HR ng ahensya ninyo. Ang lump sum ay ang contributions ninyo kasama ang interes, minsanang bayad po.
spokenText: Kailangan ng hindi bababa sa one hundred twenty monthly contributions para sa buwanang pension habambuhay. Kulang dito, lump sum na lang ang ibibigay ng SSS. text: Nakabayad na po kayo ng 96 monthly contributions. Ilan pa hanggang 120?
spokenText: Nakabayad na po kayo ng ninety-six monthly contributions. Ilan pa hanggang one hundred twenty?

text: 120 ay sampung taon. Itanong po sa SSS o GSIS kung ilan na talaga ang sa inyo.
spokenText: one hundred twenty ay sampung taon. Itanong po sa SSS o GSIS kung ilan na talaga ang sa inyo.

text: Pareho ang halagang dumarating kada buwan, buong taon. Tapos may pangalawang deposito sa Disyembre.
spokenText: Pareho ang halagang dumarating kada buwan, buong taon. Tapos may pangalawang deposito sa Disyembre.

text: Nagbibigay ang SSS ng 13th month pension tuwing Disyembre. Kapareho ito ng isang buwang pension, walang kailangang i-apply. Ang GSIS naman ay nagbibigay ng Christmas cash gift. Isang buwang pension o ₱10,000, alinman ang mas mababa. Awtomatiko itong dumarating, dagdag sa regular na pension sa Disyembre. Illustrative: ang ₱4,500 na buwanang pension ay may dagdag na ₱4,500 sa Disyembre.
spokenText: Nagbibigay ang SSS ng thirteenth month pension tuwing Disyembre. Kapareho ito ng isang buwang pension, walang kailangang i-apply. Ang GSIS naman ay nagbibigay ng Christmas cash gift. Isang buwang pension o ten thousand pesos, alinman ang mas mababa. Awtomatiko itong dumarating, dagdag sa regular na pension sa Disyembre. Illustrative: ang four thousand five hundred pesos na buwanang pension ay may dagdag na four thousand five hundred pesos sa Disyembre.

text: Ang buwanang pension ninyo ay ₱4,500 po. I-slide ang hula ninyo: magkano ang dagdag sa Disyembre?
spokenText: Ang buwanang pension ninyo ay four thousand five hundred pesos po. I-slide ang hula ninyo: magkano ang dagdag sa Disyembre?

text: Umasa po ng dalawang deposito sa Disyembre, hindi isa lang. Planuhin ang dalawa.
spokenText: Umasa po ng dalawang deposito sa Disyembre, hindi isa lang. Planuhin ang dalawa.

text: Tinatanggap ng My.SSS at SSS mobile app ang online na retirement claim. Ang GSIS members ay nag-file sa eServices portal ng ahensya nila. Mag-upload po ng valid ID at detalye ng bank account ninyo. Mag-file bago ang huling araw ninyo ng trabaho, hindi pagkatapos.

text: Ayusin po ang mga hakbang sa pag-file ng SSS retirement claim online.

text: Minsan sa isang taon, may hihilingin ang SSS sa ilang pensioner. Kasama ang 80 pataas, nasa abroad, at disability o survivor pensioners. Kumpirmahin nilang buhay pa sila. Sa GSIS, lahat ng pensioner. Kapag nilaktawan, titigil ang pension.

text: Ito ang Annual Confirmation of Pensioners. Pinoprotektahan nito ang fund sa pagbabayad ng pension na walang tumatanggap. Kumpirma po sa branch, o sa app gamit ang facial check, tinatanggap mula Marso 2026. Ang di-nakumpirmang taon ay nagsususpinde ng pension hanggang kumpirma po kayo. Dalawang taong walang kumpirmasyon, kakanselahin ito.
spokenText: Ito ang Annual Confirmation of Pensioners. Pinoprotektahan nito ang fund sa pagbabayad ng pension na walang tumatanggap. text: Kumpirma po bawat taon, sa tamang oras. Nagpapatuloy nito ang pension.

text: May tumawag, sabing na-compromise ang account ninyo. Kailangan daw niya ang OTP na dumating sa phone ninyo para ayusin ito.
spokenText: May tumawag, sabing na-compromise ang account ninyo. Kailangan daw niya ang OTP na dumating sa phone ninyo para ayusin ito.

text: Walang empleyado ng bangko ang hihingi ng OTP ninyo, kahit para protektahan ang account ninyo. Sa inyo lang po dapat ang OTP. Alam na po ng tunay na bangko ang detalye ng account ninyo. Papalitan ng bangko ang OTP sa mga mapanganib na transaksyon sa 2026.
spokenText: Walang empleyado ng bangko ang hihingi ng OTP ninyo, kahit para protektahan ang account ninyo. Sa inyo lang po dapat ang OTP. Alam na po ng tunay na bangko ang detalye ng account ninyo. Papalitan ng bangko ang OTP sa mga mapanganib na transaksyon sa two thousand twenty-six.

spokenText: Dalawampung segundo. May dumating na mensahe, sabi galing sa apo ninyo. Basahin po nang mabuti.

spokenText: May mga mensaheng ginawa sa urgency, bagong number, at request na manahimik na lang kayo. I-tap po ang linyang may pag-aalinlangan.

spokenText: I-tap po ang mga linyang dapat magpapatigil sa inyo bago magpadala ng pera.

spokenText: May tumawag, sabing titigil ang PhilHealth benefits ninyo ngayon, kung hindi kayo magbabayad ng fee.

spokenText: Hindi kailanman sinususpinde ng SSS at PhilHealth ang benefit sa tawag o text link. Ayusin po kung alin ang tunay at alin ang huwad.

spokenText: I-sort po ang bawat card. Kaliwa ay tunay, kanan ay scam.

spokenText: Pinapayagan kayo pong mag-verify muna ng tunay na ahensya. Pinapabilis kayo ng scammer.

spokenText: Siyamnapung segundo. Sampung pahayag tungkol sa investment seminars at scam na laban sa retirees.

spokenText: I-check po ang listahan ng SEC bago ang seminar, hindi pagkatapos kayo magbayad.

text: Bawat senior citizen ay PhilHealth member na sa batas, RA 10645. Walang application, walang babayarang premium. Nagsisimula po ang membership sa sandaling mag-sisenta kayo. Nagbabayad ang PhilHealth ng fixed na halaga bawat sakit, hindi ang buong bill. Sinakop ng PhilHealth ang mga 52% ng karaniwang hospital bill noong 2023. Bumababa pa ang bahagi.
spokenText: Bawat senior citizen ay PhilHealth member na sa batas, RA ten thousand six hundred forty-five. Walang application, walang babayarang premium. Nagsisimula po ang membership sa sandaling mag-sisenta kayo. Nagbabayad ang PhilHealth ng fixed na halaga bawat sakit, hindi ang buong bill. Sinakop ng PhilHealth ang mga fifty-two percent ng karaniwang hospital bill noong two thousand twenty-three. Bumababa pa ang bahagi.

text: Nag-sisenta na po kayo ngayong taon. Kailangan pa po ba ninyong mag-apply para sa PhilHealth membership?
spokenText: Nag-sisenta na po kayo ngayong taon. Kailangan pa po ba ninyong mag-apply para sa PhilHealth membership?

text: Ang pag-sisenta ninyo na po mismo ang gumawa sa inyong PhilHealth member.
spokenText: Ang pag-sisenta ninyo na po mismo ang gumawa sa inyong PhilHealth member.

text: Kino-ring up ng cashier ang gamot ninyo. Binabawasan agad ng twenty percent bago pa kayo humingi.
spokenText: Kino-ring up ng cashier ang gamot ninyo. Binabawasan agad ng twenty percent bago pa kayo humingi.

text: Binibigyan ng RA 9994 ang senior ng 20% discount. May VAT exemption din sa ilang pang-araw-araw na bili. Sakop ang gamot, medical at dental services, at funeral services. Sakop din ang restaurant food, transport fares, at hotel stays. May 5% discount ang kuryente at tubig kung nasa pangalan ninyo ang account.
spokenText: Binibigyan ng RA nine thousand nine hundred ninety-four ang senior ng twenty percent discount. May VAT exemption din sa ilang pang-araw-araw na bili. Sakop ang gamot, medical at dental services, at funeral services. Sakop din ang restaurant food, transport fares, at hotel stays. May five percent discount ang kuryente at tubig kung nasa pangalan ninyo ang account.

text: I-match ang bawat bili sa discount na kasama nito.
spokenText: I-match ang bawat bili sa discount na kasama nito.

text: Limang kategorya, iisang ID. Dalhin po ito tuwing gumagastos kayo.
spokenText: Limang kategorya, iisang ID. Dalhin po ito tuwing gumagastos kayo.

text: ₱336 ang nasa tag. Sabi ng cashier, ₱240 ang bayad ninyo. Gusto ninyong tsekin ang kwenta.
spokenText: three hundred thirty-six pesos ang nasa tag. Sabi ng cashier, two hundred forty pesos ang bayad ninyo. Gusto ninyong tsekin ang kwenta.

text: May 12% VAT na sa presyo sa tag. Alisin muna ang VAT, saka bawasan ng 20%. ₱336 ÷ 1.12 ang nag-aalis ng VAT, ₱300 ang matitira. 20% ng ₱300 ay ₱60, kaya ₱240 ang babayaran ninyo.
spokenText: May twelve percent VAT na sa presyo sa tag. text: Nakatag ang gamot ng ₱336, kasama ang VAT. Magkano ang babayaran ninyo gamit ang senior discount?
spokenText: Nakatag ang gamot ng three hundred thirty-six pesos, kasama ang VAT. Magkano ang babayaran ninyo gamit ang senior discount?

text: Suriin po ninyo mismo ang kwenta. Dapat makita sa resibo ang dalawang bawas.
spokenText: Suriin po ninyo mismo ang kwenta. Dapat makita sa resibo ang dalawang bawas.

text: Para sa sariling bili ng senior citizen ang discount, hindi para sa kasama.

spokenText: Ang ID ay para sa sarili ninyong bili, hindi sa kasama.

spokenText: Dalawang beses tiningnan ng cashier ang ID ninyo, sabing hindi raw ito sapat.

spokenText: May mga counter na tumututol kahit valid ang ID. Ang kaalaman sa patakaran ang bumabantay ng discount ninyo.

text: Bagong plano ang retirement, hindi lang baligtad ng dati.
spokenText: Bagong plano ang retirement, hindi lang baligtad ng dati.

text: Hatiin ang retirement savings sa tatlong bucket: cash, bonds at MP2, at growth. Bucket one: cash para sa susunod na taon, ligtas at handa. Bucket two: bonds at MP2 para sa susunod na limang taon. Bucket three: ang natitira, iniiwan para lumago nang mas matagal.
spokenText: Hatiin ang retirement savings sa tatlong bucket: cash, bonds at MP2, at growth. Bucket one: cash para sa susunod na taon, ligtas at handa. Bucket two: bonds at MP2 para sa susunod na limang taon. Bucket three: ang natitira, iniiwan para lumago nang mas matagal.

text: Hatiin po ang ₱2,000,000 sa tatlong bucket.
spokenText: Hatiin po ang two million pesos sa tatlong bucket.

spokenText: Ang isang taong cash ay labindalawang buwang pangangailangan, nasa bangkong PDIC-insured. Sini-insure ng PDIC ang deposito hanggang one million pesos kada depositor, kada bangko. Ang bucket na ito ay para gastusin, hindi para lumago.

text: ₱10,000 ang buwanang pangangailangan ninyo. Magkano ang ilalagay sa bucket one, para sa isang taon?
spokenText: ten thousand pesos ang buwanang pangangailangan ninyo. Magkano ang ilalagay sa bucket one, para sa isang taon?
